people.name: Egypt

people.name: Solomon
people.line: Son of David, king of Israel, known for his wisdom.

translations.web: Solomon’s wisdom excelled the wisdom of all the children of the east and all the wisdom of Egypt.
translations.bsb: Solomon’s wisdom was greater than that of all the men of the East, greater than all the wisdom of Egypt.
translations.kjv: And Solomon's wisdom excelled the wisdom of all the children of the east country, and all the wisdom of Egypt.
